idea_angle: Net worth is one of the most-searched money terms. How to calculate yours in four lines, with a fictional 27-year-old whose number is negative, and why that's normal early on.

script.title: Net worth: how to calculate yours in 4 lines
script.hook: Your net worth is one number, and it takes 4 lines to find it. Here's how.

segments.heading: Hook
segments.narration: Your net worth is one number, and it takes four lines to find it. Here's how.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. the small round green piggy bank mascot with big eyes a single page with four lines. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Line 1
segments.narration: Line one: everything you own that has a cash value. Checking, savings, retirement accounts, and what your car would sell for today.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a jar, a small car and a piggy bank. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Line 2
segments.narration: Line two: everything you owe. Card balances, car loan, student loans, anything else with a balance.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a stack of bills. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Lines 3 and 4
segments.narration: Line three: subtract. Line four: the date. Fictional example: own nineteen thousand, owe twenty-seven thousand. Net worth: minus eight thousand.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a scale tipping slightly. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Rule
segments.narration: Negative is common in your twenties. The point isn't the number. It's whether it goes up from here.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. an arrow pointing up. No text, no logos, no real people.

script.cta: Follow for one money move a week.
script.caption:
How to calculate your net worth (fictional example):
Own: cash $3,200 + retirement $9,800 + car $6,000 = $19,000
Owe: card $1,400 + car loan $7,600 + student loans $18,000 = $27,000
Net worth: −$8,000

Negative is common early on. Recalculate every 3 months and watch the direction.

Fictional example for illustration, not a real person.

Follow for one money move a week.
script.description: How to calculate your net worth in four lines, with a fictional example.

tiktok_extra.heading: The numbers
tiktok_extra.narration: In our example: cash thirty-two hundred, retirement ninety-eight hundred, car six thousand. Owed: a card at fourteen hundred, a car loan at seventy-six hundred, and eighteen thousand in student loans.
tiktok_extra.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. two columns of coins. No text, no logos, no real people.

tiktok_extra.heading: Car value
tiktok_extra.narration: Use what the car would sell for today, not what you paid. Most cars lose value every year, so this line usually shrinks.
tiktok_extra.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a car with a price tag. No text, no logos, no real people.

tiktok_extra.heading: Don't count
tiktok_extra.narration: Leave out things you'd never sell, like your clothes or your phone. Keep it to things with a real cash value.
tiktok_extra.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a phone with a small cross. No text, no logos, no real people.

tiktok_extra.heading: Every 3 months
tiktok_extra.narration: Recalculate every three months, same day each time. Paying down the card and adding to savings both move the number up.
tiktok_extra.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a calendar with four ticks. No text, no logos, no real people.

idea_angle: What is a good credit score? On the common FICO scale (300-850), 670-739 is generally 'good', 740-799 'very good', 800+ 'exceptional'. Plus why there's no single score.

script.title: What is a good credit score? The 5 FICO ranges
script.hook: Most scores run from 300 to 850. Here's where 'good' starts, and why you have more than one score.

segments.heading: Hook
segments.narration: Most credit scores run from three hundred to eight fifty. Here's where good starts, and why you have more than one score.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. the small round green piggy bank mascot with big eyes a dial from 300 to 850. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Ranges
segments.narration: On the common FICO scale: below five eighty is poor, five eighty to six sixty-nine is fair, six seventy to seven thirty-nine is good.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a dial with three colored bands. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Top
segments.narration: Seven forty to seven ninety-nine is very good, and eight hundred and up is exceptional.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. the dial's top bands highlighted. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: More than one
segments.narration: You don't have one score. Different lenders use different models and different bureaus, so your numbers can differ by a few points or more.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. three small dials side by side. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Rule
segments.narration: Pay every bill on time and keep card balances low. Those two habits move every version of the score.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a calendar tick and a small card. No text, no logos, no real people.

script.cta: Follow for one money move a week.
script.caption:
What is a good credit score?
On the common FICO scale (300–850):
Below 580: poor
580–669: fair
670–739: good
740–799: very good
800+: exceptional

You have several scores (different models and bureaus). The two habits that move all of them: pay on time, keep card balances low.

Ranges are FICO's; other models use different cut-offs. Educational, not financial advice.

Follow for one money move a week.
script.description: What counts as a good credit score, using FICO's ranges.
claims_to_verify: FICO ranges: <580 poor, 580–669 fair, 670–739 good, 740–799 very good, 800+ exceptional (myFICO/Experian)

tiktok_extra.heading: Why it matters
tiktok_extra.narration: The range matters most when you borrow. A better score can mean a lower rate on a car loan or mortgage, which adds up over years of payments.
tiktok_extra.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a loan document with a smaller number. No text, no logos, no real people.

tiktok_extra.heading: What counts most
tiktok_extra.narration: For FICO, payment history is the biggest factor, about thirty-five percent, and amounts owed are about thirty percent.
tiktok_extra.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a pie chart with two big slices. No text, no logos, no real people.

tiktok_extra.heading: Check free
tiktok_extra.narration: You can see your credit reports free every week at AnnualCreditReport dot com. Many banks and card apps also show a free score.
tiktok_extra.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a laptop with a report. No text, no logos, no real people.

tiktok_extra.heading: Not instant
tiktok_extra.narration: Scores change as new information is reported, usually monthly, so give a new habit a few months before you judge it.
tiktok_extra.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a calendar with three pages. No text, no logos, no real people.

script.title: Best high-yield savings rates: how to check this month's
script.hook: Your savings could be earning $20 a year or $200 on the same $5,000. Here's how to check this month's rates.

segments.narration: Your savings could be earning twenty dollars a year or two hundred on the same five thousand. Here's how to check this month's rates.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. the small round green piggy bank mascot with big eyes two jars, one fuller. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Baseline
segments.narration: Start with the FDIC's national average savings rate. It's published every month, and it's well under one percent.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a small chart on a page. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Compare
segments.narration: Then look at what online high-yield accounts pay this month. Illustrative math: at point four percent, five thousand earns about twenty dollars a year. At four percent, about two hundred.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a calculator with two results. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Check
segments.narration: Before you switch: is it at an FDIC-insured bank, are there monthly fees, and is there a minimum balance?
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a checklist with three boxes. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Rule
segments.narration: Rates are variable and can drop after a Fed decision, so recheck every few months.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a calendar with a circle. No text, no logos, no real people.

idea_angle: How much house can I afford? The 28/36 guideline worked on a fictional $6,000 gross monthly income with a $400 car payment, plus the upfront cash most people forget.

script.title: How much house can I afford? The 28/36 math
script.hook: On $6,000 a month before tax, the 28/36 guideline puts your housing at about $1,680. Here's the math.

segments.heading: Hook
segments.narration: On six thousand a month before tax, the twenty-eight thirty-six guideline puts your housing at about sixteen eighty. Here's the math.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. the small round green piggy bank mascot with big eyes a small house on a scale. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.narration: Twenty-eight: housing, meaning mortgage, property tax and insurance, at about twenty-eight percent of gross monthly income. Six thousand times point two eight is sixteen eighty.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a calculator with a house icon. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.narration: Thirty-six: all debt payments, including housing, at about thirty-six percent. That's twenty-one sixty. With a four-hundred-dollar car payment, housing can be up to seventeen sixty.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. two stacked bars. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Lower wins
segments.narration: Use the lower of the two: sixteen eighty. Lenders may approve more, but that doesn't mean the budget can carry it.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a pointer at the smaller bar. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Cash
segments.narration: Then add the upfront cash: the down payment plus closing costs, often a few percent of the price. Fictional numbers; it's a guideline, not a rule.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a jar with a key. No text, no logos, no real people.

script.cta: Follow for one money move a week.
script.caption:
How much house can I afford? The 28/36 guideline (fictional example):
Gross income: $6,000 a month
28% for housing (mortgage, taxes, insurance): $1,680
36% for all debts: $2,160 − $400 car = $1,760
Use the lower: about $1,680 a month

Plus: down payment and closing costs, often a few percent of the price. A guideline, not a rule; lenders may approve more than your budget can carry.

Fictional example. Educational, not financial advice.

Follow for one money move a week.
script.description: The 28/36 guideline for how much house you can afford, worked on a fictional income.
claims_to_verify: 28/36 is a common lender guideline, not a law (CFPB on DTI)
Closing costs often a few percent of price (CFPB)

tiktok_extra.heading: Take-home check
tiktok_extra.narration: Check it against take-home pay too. If sixteen eighty is more than about a third of what actually lands in your account, the month will feel tight.
tiktok_extra.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a paycheck next to a house. No text, no logos, no real people.

tiktok_extra.heading: Hidden costs
tiktok_extra.narration: Owning adds costs renting doesn't: repairs, maintenance, maybe HOA fees. Many people set aside one to two percent of the home's value a year.
tiktok_extra.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a small toolbox. No text, no logos, no real people.

tiktok_extra.heading: Rate matters
tiktok_extra.narration: The same monthly payment buys less house when rates are higher. Ask lenders for a Loan Estimate, so you can compare the full cost side by side.
tiktok_extra.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. two forms side by side. No text, no logos, no real people.

tiktok_extra.heading: Emergency fund
tiktok_extra.narration: Keep an emergency fund after closing. Using every dollar for the down payment leaves nothing for the first broken water heater.
tiktok_extra.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a jar beside a house. No text, no logos, no real people.
